notes: Concept artist's impressions of the Phase 1 improvements. Indicative only.

concepts.title: The amber route
concepts.caption: A bright amber path on the ground leads you out of the city centre. Clear wayfinders show the way and the walking time to the Knowledge Quarter.
concepts.alt: Concept artwork: the amber route. A bright amber path on the ground leads you out of the city centre. Clear wayfinders show the way and the walking time to the Knowledge Quarter.

concepts.title: The safer crossing
concepts.caption: A new signal-controlled crossing at the Dartmouth and Jennens junction, with an island in the middle, so people on foot and on bikes can cross the main road safely.
concepts.alt: Concept artwork: the safer crossing. A new signal-controlled crossing at the Dartmouth and Jennens junction, with an island in the middle, so people on foot and on bikes can cross the main road safely.

concepts.title: The gateway pavilion
concepts.caption: A welcoming timber pavilion marks the front door to the Knowledge Quarter, with seating, planting and a wayfinder hub. It can be taken away again later.
concepts.alt: Concept artwork: the gateway pavilion. A welcoming timber pavilion marks the front door to the Knowledge Quarter, with seating, planting and a wayfinder hub. It can be taken away again later.

concepts.title: The pavilion from above
concepts.caption: Seen from above, the pavilion sits on a public square where the amber route arrives, giving the Knowledge Quarter a clear, green welcome.
concepts.alt: Concept artwork: the pavilion from above. Seen from above, the pavilion sits on a public square where the amber route arrives, giving the Knowledge Quarter a clear, green welcome.
